scope: 65 newly supported Ability components, 58 fully supported cards.
boundaries: Only complete recognized clauses are mapped; unresolved components keep whole cards unsupported.
EX and EX_LEGACY remain distinct; V includes audited VMAX and VSTAR membership.
Damage-only guards never prevent counters or status; full guards preserve source kind and opposing-owner relations.
Attacker identity, attached Special Energy and canonical-name exclusions are read from authoritative field state.
Bench protection evaluates each recipient; full-HP reduction uses current damage counters; suppression and defender damage bypass remain live.
